title: Answers match an exhaustive oracle on 12 synthetic cases

dataset.note: Cases and oracle were written by the same team as the method. Not market data and not an independent audit.

protocol: Run the method on every case and compare status and minimum cost with the enumeration oracle in validation/portfolio-method-02/benchmark.py. Reproduce with app/kalis-runner/client/local-test.mjs.

verifier.who: Kalis team (same as the demo seller)

limits: Small synthetic cases with three assets.
A plain AI prompt also solved these 12 cases (RANCANGAN section 42), so this shows correctness, not an advantage over AI.
